sample_size.rationale: With zero confirmed changes among 450 units, the exact one-sided binomial upper bound is 0.6636% per profile. Using alpha 0.05/4 gives a conservative simultaneous upper bound of 0.9691% across the four shipped conditions (production, studio, lowband, restore). These bounds assume independent representative units; speaker-block sensitivity and cluster-aware intervals are mandatory, and more units must be added if effective sample size is lower.

speaker_demographics: adult age band where collection rights permit
coverage_requirements.rule: Freeze quotas using rights-cleared inventory before candidate generation; report every predefined stratum and add data rather than silently pooling an underfilled primary stratum.

leakage_checks: speaker identity disjoint across calibration, acceptance, and reserve

outcomes.definition: A candidate introduces, deletes, substitutes, repeats, or meaningfully reorders a spoken word or changes a negation, name, number, or other meaning-bearing content relative to the adjudicated source.
outcomes.measure: adjudicated binary verdict per source-unit/profile comparison

outcomes.definition: The shipped output contains a confirmed content change in a unit for which the product selected processed audio rather than the original.
outcomes.measure: adjudicated count and exact one-sided confidence bound per profile

outcomes.definition: The product selected the original because of Guard A or Guard B even though dual review confirmed that the final discarded processed candidate preserved content.
outcomes.measure: content-safe discarded-candidate rate with cluster-aware interval; reported as guard efficiency and no-op risk, never used as a linguistic oracle

outcomes.definition: Sorani keyword/content recognition relative to the transcript locked before processing.
outcomes.measure: blind scored critical-token accuracy and paired intelligibility rating; Sorani pilot locks the scoring key before held-out use

outcomes.definition: Processing-induced musical noise, chirping, pumping, smearing, discontinuity, phase image damage, or other audible defect.
outcomes.measure: 0 none, 1 mild, 2 moderate, 3 severe, 4 unusable; source-existing defects are recorded separately

outcomes.definition: Preference between time-aligned original and candidate after content review is locked.
outcomes.measure: candidate, original, or tie; ties score one half for the candidate in the declared win-rate analysis

reviewer_qualification: passes a training and qualification set with known content alterations
has not developed or tuned the candidate under review
procedure: A data custodian locks the rights-cleared source, transcript, split, profile render, alignment, and anonymous comparison ID.
Two reviewers independently listen to source and candidate, inspect the locked transcript, and record content, intelligibility, and artifact verdicts without profile identity.

For every unit ultimately reverted by Guard A or Guard B, the same dual-review rule is also applied to the final discarded processed candidate so guard false reverts are measured rather than inferred.
Reviewers identify exact timecodes and content tokens for any suspected change; ASR output may prioritize review but cannot clear a sample.
Any disagreement or suspected change goes to a third qualified adjudicator who remains profile-blind and records a reasoned final verdict.
The mapping from anonymous system IDs to profiles is opened only after all verdicts, exclusions, and analysis inputs are locked.
agreement_reporting: Cohen kappa for paired binary content verdicts
Krippendorff alpha for ordinal artifact ratings
adjudication rate by profile and stratum

listening_test.design: balanced incomplete randomized blocks with source and system order counter-balanced
quality_controls: quiet-environment attestation or documented laboratory chain
training examples outside all evaluation splits
listening_test.pilot_rule: Use only the reviewer-training/calibration split to translate instructions, validate anchors, estimate variance and clustering, and increase the listener or rating count for 90% power at the locked margins. Never reduce the stated floors.

analysis.analysis_lock: Code, model formulae, seed derivation, stratum map, QC rules, and table shells are hashed before system unblinding.
analysis.estimands: paired candidate-minus-original effects per profile, plus predefined dialect, environment, degradation, capture, and critical-content strata
analysis.model: paired hierarchical mixed-effects analysis checked by a speaker-block and listener-block bootstrap; report both and use the more conservative release conclusion
analysis.confidence: one-sided 95% intervals for release gates and two-sided 95% intervals for descriptive estimates

release_thresholds.profile_value_rule: After every safety and non-inferiority gate passes, each profile must also have a Holm-adjusted lower confidence bound above zero for OVRL or BAK in an intended degradation stratum, or a blinded-preference lower bound above 0.5.

analysis.stratum_rule: No aggregate can conceal a confirmed content change or severe introduced artifact. Report every locked stratum, its sample count and uncertainty; label underpowered strata rather than pooling them post hoc.
analysis.missingness_rule: Report missing and invalid ratings with reasons. Exclude listeners only by locked QC rules; a missing unit-level render or review is a failed gate, not missing data.
sensitivity: speaker-cluster effective sample size and zero-event bound
with and without adjudicated reviewer disagreements

allowed_source_exclusions: rights or consent not adequate for this evaluation
corrupt or truncated source before product processing
source transcript cannot be resolved by blinded adjudication
exclusions.rule: Apply source exclusions without examining any candidate or candidate-derived metric. Preserve excluded IDs and reasons in the audit ledger; never substitute an easier unit after a failure.

stop_actions: freeze and hash the complete evidence state
quarantine the affected candidate and stop any release claim
determine scope on already exposed material without tuning against hidden reserve labels
rerun final acceptance on the untouched reserve or a newly rights-cleared holdout
stopping_and_regression.regression_rule: Every later source, model, dependency, profile, threshold, or output-changing code revision must rerun the complete locked acceptance protocol on untouched evidence. A metadata-only change may reuse evidence only after a documented bitwise-output equivalence proof.
prohibited: dropping a failed profile or stratum after unblinding
treating ASR agreement as human content clearance

data_governance.repository_artifacts: Only hash-locked manifests, anonymous reviewer IDs, verdicts, statistics, scripts, and redacted evidence may be committed.
data_governance.access: Separate least-privilege roles for data custody, candidate generation, linguistic review, statistical analysis, and final unblinding; log every held-out access.

restoration_addendum.disclosure: outputs are labeled reconstructions, not recovered speech
restoration_addendum.rationale: Restore mode synthesizes bandwidth above the detected cutoff. Content below the cutoff is protected by construction and re-verified; everything above it is generated conditioned on a speaker profile. Evaluating it as recovery would be a false claim regardless of scores.
stop_rules: confirmed speaker identity mismatch in any shipped restore unit
protected-band alteration beyond locked tolerance in any shipped restore unit
any shipped restore unit distributed without reconstruction disclosure
restoration_addendum.source_strata: restore units must come from genuinely band-limited sources (telephony, codec, archival) with the detected cutoff recorded per unit; full-band sources are bypass cases and count toward no restore stratum
restoration_addendum.speaker_identity_gate: blinded native-listener speaker match against enrollment audio for every restore unit, in addition to the content-integrity dual review
